fields.PRODUCT NAME: Rajasthani Marble Meenakari Box (Red & White with Kundan Work) /Sindoor Dabbi
fields.DESCRIPTION: Add a regal touch to your home décor with this exquisite handcrafted marble box, adorned with traditional Meenakari art and Kundan embellishments. The bright red and white base is beautifully decorated with floral motifs in gold and green, highlighted with sparkling stone inlays.
